newsitem.title: UK: BT contains falls, aided by merger plans.
newsitem.headline: BT contains falls, aided by merger plans.

text.p: Shares in British Telecommunications (BT) were largely resisting overall market losses on Monday as positive sentiment on expansion plans restricted falls, traders said.
Shares, which saw the heaviest early volumes, were down three pence to 438.5 pence as the FTSE 100 index slipped 37.7 points to 4,233.0.

"There is a generally positive sentiment, partly ahead of the extraordinary general meeting (EGM) to approve the merger with MCI and partly on news of its alliance with Portugal Telecom," said one analyst who asked not to be identified.
BT holds its EGM on Tuesday for approval of its planned merger with MCI Communications Corp.
BT said on Monday that it had formed a strategic alliance with MCI and Portugal Telecom SA to gain a strong position in fast growing markets in Portugal and Latin America.
Under the alliance's terms, BT will take a one percent stake in Portugal Telecom while MCI will take 0.5 percent.
Portugal Telecom will become the sole distributor for Concert Communications Services' voice products in Portugal.
The Portuguese telecoms firm and MCI will also explore activities in Brazil's $14 billion market.
"The Portugal deal is a marginal positive, but it highlights again BT's expansion plans," the analyst said. -- London Newsroom +44171 542 7717
